facts.fact: Knapsack Creative cites a benchmark that 51% of consumers feel a brand relationship starts when the brand understands them and their desires.
facts.quote: 51% of consumers feel a brand relationship starts when the brand “understands them and their desires”

facts.fact: Genesys Growth's landing page benchmark roundup reports that landing pages written at a 5th to 7th grade reading level convert at 11.1%, compared with 5.3% for copy at a college reading level.
facts.quote: landing pages with a 5th to 7th grade reading level convert at 11.1%, compared with 5.3% for copy written at a college reading level

facts.fact: According to WordStream's CRO statistics roundup (third-party source cited by Adwave), user-generated content on 1,200 websites produced a 3.2% conversion rate.
facts.quote: cites that user-generated content on 1,200 websites produced a 3.2% conversion rate, and conversions increased by an additional 3.8% when visitors engaged with that UGC

facts.fact: According to WordStream's CRO statistics roundup (third-party source cited by Adwave), conversions increased by an additional 3.8% when visitors engaged with user-generated content.
facts.quote: conversions increased by an additional 3.8% when visitors engaged with that UGC

facts.fact: According to Rob Palmer's website copywriting guidance (third-party source cited by Adwave), first-person CTAs can outperform second-person CTAs by 25% to 90%.
facts.quote: cites tests showing first-person CTAs can outperform second-person CTAs by 25% to 90%
